deploy.startCommand: bash -c 'echo "[startup] ffmpeg:" && ffmpeg -version 2>&1 | head -3 && echo "[startup] ffmpeg encoders:" && ffmpeg -encoders 2>&1 | grep -E "libx264|h264|aac" | head -10 && echo "[startup] starting uvicorn on port ${PORT:-8000}" && uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8000}'
